gen-gf-unica-one-gf-alumni-sans: Unica One draws round letters with huge open eyes and every stroke the same width, like wire bent into shape. Alumni Sans is the restful one, with a wide-open c and only modest swings in stroke weight as the text runs on.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anaheim: Unica One is all flat-pen confidence, with no calligraphic shading and big open curves that make a heading hard to miss. And Anaheim packs its rounded, lowercase-as-capitals glyphs into a tight huddle that the eye slides through.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-basic: Unica One has a very large lowercase eye and a ruler-drawn line of constant width, a heading that looks cut with a straightedge. Basic gives the text a gentle step up from small letters to capitals.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-courier-prime: Courier Prime lays down lowercase that fills most of the height, with the steady line of a technical drafting pen. Courier Prime keeps that precise, structured rhythm going down the page, while Unica One supplies the display punch above.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-fragment-mono: Rigid as a drafting table, Fragment Mono sets tall-waisted letters out like nails on a ruler, with no contrast in stroke weight to slow the eye. Under Unica One's commanding display shapes, it reads with a steady, mechanical tick.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-magra: Magra gives every lowercase word a big-bodied feel, while Unica One above it keeps its curves free of pinched joins or swelling bowls. Over many lines it stays professional and unfussy.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar tucks its ascenders short and stays approachable, while Unica One above it looks drawn with a marker tip. Both are distinctive in their own way, and the marker-tip heading is the pair's loudest feature.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-narnoor: Not a hint of stroke contrast slows Unica One, whose very large open eyes make it a commanding display face. Narnoor handles the quieter job, with short ascenders over big bowls that keep running text professional.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-play: Curves as heavy as the stems, like cord, give Unica One its commanding display look. And Play, with little height difference between cases and a faint thinning of the strokes like soft stamped metal, stays clean in text, so keep it modest next to the heading.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-ramabhadra: Unica One draws every curve with a single-weight line, as a plotter pen would, and leaves visible daylight in each round letter. Ramabhadra does the quieter work, its prominent x-height keeping the text clean.
